needs_atom.missing: An ordinal on LifeLostEvent: 'Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn' is the first life-loss event of the turn for you (CR 603.2). LifeLostEvent (2026-11-06) has only actor; only CastSpellEvent and CardDrawnEvent carry ordinal ('your second card each turn'). No trigger condition can stand in: EVENT_THIS_TURN counts life rows by their amount, so a first loss of 3 already counts 3 and a later loss cannot be told from the first. The effect maps (Scion of the Swarm's PUT_COUNTER on the source); needed: LifeLostEvent(actor=YOU, ordinal=1), counted per player by the binder like CardDrawnEvent.ordinal.
